results.title: UPDATE: The bandits who invaded Birnin Tudu community in Gummi LGA, Zamfara State, have been chased away by local vigilantes.
results.description:
UPDATE: The bandits who invaded Birnin Tudu community in Gummi LGA, Zamfara State, have been chased away by local vigilantes.

Thankfully, no one was killed, injured or abducted, and no livestock was looted or rustled before the bandits fled.

Kudos to the vigilantes for standing up to the attackers and protecting their community. Their bravery and quick response deserve to be commended

results.title: Gold miners in Zamfara State are facing growing security threats as armed groups demand levies on mining activities and attempt to take cont
results.description:
Gold miners in Zamfara State are facing growing security threats as armed groups demand levies on mining activities and attempt to take control of mineral rich areas.

The situation threatens mining operations in one of Nigeria’s gold rich states, as bandits seek to profit from the region’s mineral resources.
